ux.premise: Get to D.C. with your health, sanity, and dignity intact. The road has other plans.
ux.classic_desc: Broken systems. Dubious advice. A fighting chance. The original trail, with plenty of political absurdity.
ux.deep_desc: The same road, a worse reality. Stranger encounters, harsher satire, and higher volatility. For a second trip into the mess.
ux.code_help: The same code and choices replay the same journey. CL is Classic; DP is The Deep End.
ux.code_error: Enter a valid CL- or DP- run code ending in two digits.
ux.pants_help: A fictional danger meter. Rushed travel, doomscrolling and risky encounters raise it; calmer choices and recovery lower it. At 100%, a National Pants Emergency ends the run.
ux.onboarding: Check your supplies and conditions, then travel one day. Choices show known effects; the next screen explains what actually changed.
ux.prepare_help: Buy what you need, keep an eye on your budget, and review your load before leaving.
ux.store_error: The store could not load. Return to the title and try again.
ux.resolve_first: Resolve the current situation before traveling.
ux.save_error: Your journey could not be saved on this device.
ux.camp_hint: Opening camp costs nothing. Recovery and repairs use the resources and time shown below.
ux.repair_help: The next day resolves the breakdown using the journey’s repair rules and available equipment. Review the result before continuing.
ux.rest: Rest · Sanity +{sanity}, Health +{hp}, Supplies {supplies}, Pants {pants} · {days} day
ux.forage: Forage · Base supplies +{supplies} (varies by region) · {days} day
ux.camp_cooldown: An action is unavailable while its recovery cooldown is active.
ux.rested: A little rest. The country will still be broken in the morning.
ux.foraged: You found supplies. Apparently self-reliance comes in discarded packaging.
ux.boss_hint: The filibuster resolves in one action. Endure the debate, then learn the result of the vote.
ux.boss_resolution: The debate ends early if sanity reaches zero or pants danger reaches 100%. Otherwise, a final vote decides your run.

beltway_briefing.name: Department of Renaming Things
beltway_briefing.desc: Trump’s geographic renaming order has inspired another round of local rebranding. Your permit names yesterday’s destination. Today’s amendments rename it again. The bridge remains structurally unsound, but its name has never been stronger. Read the amendments, skim the summary, or let counsel untangle the paperwork.

classic_bridge_crews.name: The Efficiency Emergency
classic_bridge_crews.desc: The administration’s five-accomplishment emails have arrived here in spirit, if not in competence. An efficiency drive dismissed the bridge crew. The crew came back to help anyway; the savings board still celebrates their eliminated salaries. Lend a hand or document what the board leaves out.

deep_secure_line.name: National Security Family Plan
deep_secure_line.desc: After the Trump administration’s Signal scandal, everyone is checking who else is listening. The encrypted checkpoint chat includes a cousin, a caterer, and your entire party. The encryption works. The invitation list needs diagnostics. The technicians await your decision.
deep_secure_line.log_0: You remove the accidental guests. The encryption was never the problem.
deep_secure_line.log_1: Your staff sort out the invitations while you miss the briefing.
deep_secure_line.log_2: The review consumes supplies but produces a documented access list.

raw_milk.name: Raw Milk Stand
raw_milk.desc: The MAHA report’s citation errors have arrived before its promised confidence. The vendor’s health claims cite nine studies, three of which are expected to exist shortly. A medal-wearing cow lends institutional credibility. Drink the milk, decline, or choose sealed snacks.

tariff_whiplash.name: Tariff Whiplash
tariff_whiplash.desc: Trump’s auto-parts tariffs have turned this roadside conversation into an economics seminar nobody enrolled in. Your previous emergency has been ruled invalid. Please pay for the replacement emergency. The clerk has a fresh tariff stamp and absolutely no refund cash. Pay, smuggle supplies, or lobby for a waiver.

classic_civic_potluck.desc: The LFPA25 cancellation is today’s topic; neighbors are supplying what the talking points cannot. Local organizers insist you eat before the next leg.

classic_crossing_block_party.desc: Trump’s order to shrink IMLS has made the future of public culture the subject of this gathering. Residents host a morale party next to the jammed checkpoint.

classic_freeway_mural.desc: Trump’s geographic renaming order has inspired another round of local rebranding. Artists pause your motorcade to finish a solidarity mural.

classic_mail_drop.desc: The administration’s five-accomplishment emails have arrived here in spirit, if not in competence. Supporters sprint over with a bundle of letters asking for updates.

classic_media_training.desc: After the Trump administration’s Signal scandal, everyone is checking who else is listening. A friendly coach offers quick framing tips before the next checkpoint.

classic_mutual_aid.desc: The LFPA25 cancellation is today’s topic; neighbors are supplying what the talking points cannot. Volunteers flag you down to swap supplies for a quick broadcast boost.

classic_mutual_aid_dispatch.desc: The LFPA25 cancellation is today’s topic; neighbors are supplying what the talking points cannot. Dispatchers dart between radios matching requests to trucks.

classic_neighborhood_watch.desc: Trump’s geographic renaming order has inspired another round of local rebranding. Block captains share overnight intel and missing signage.

classic_overpass_stage.desc: Trump’s order to shrink IMLS has made the future of public culture the subject of this gathering. An allied troupe offers to headline a rapid teach-in over the freeway.

classic_press_briefing.desc: Sharpiegate is the training example: evidence must survive the person holding the marker. Local journalists ask for quick quotes before the convoy moves on.

classic_press_pool_qna.desc: After the Trump administration’s Signal scandal, everyone is checking who else is listening. Traveling reporters request an extra rotation on the bus.

classic_radio_phonebank.desc: Trump’s order to shrink IMLS has made the future of public culture the subject of this gathering. Students spin up a call-in marathon for signatures.

classic_service_station.desc: Trump’s auto-parts tariffs have turned this roadside conversation into an economics seminar nobody enrolled in. A union shop offers uptime checks before you push east.

classic_union_blockade.desc: Trump’s auto-parts tariffs have turned this roadside conversation into an economics seminar nobody enrolled in. A local union offers to stage a slowdown so you can pass unharassed.

classic_water_drive.desc: Trump’s showerhead order has inspired a debate about water pressure while actual water needs moving. A roadside relief post asks for a quick boost to their hydration drive.

deep_circuit_breaker.desc: Trump’s auto-parts tariffs have turned this roadside conversation into an economics seminar nobody enrolled in. Engineers beg to inspect the convoy's overloaded power grid.

deep_field_intel.desc: After the Trump administration’s Signal scandal, everyone is checking who else is listening. Community researchers hand over drive images and surveys.

deep_grassroots_signal.desc: After the Trump administration’s Signal scandal, everyone is checking who else is listening. Decentralized organizers beam encrypted updates from afar.

deep_media_ambush.desc: Sharpiegate is the training example: evidence must survive the person holding the marker. A crisis PR coach ambushes you with rapid-fire hypotheticals.

deep_memorandum_dump.desc: After DOGE’s billion-to-million correction, this group insists on counting the zeroes itself. Compressed drives of sealed memos await triage.

deep_state_dirge.desc: The administration’s five-accomplishment emails have arrived here in spirit, if not in competence. A shadowy hearing drags on for hours.

deep_watch_party.desc: Sharpiegate is the training example: evidence must survive the person holding the marker. A secure bunker hosts remote testimonies late into the night.

deep_watchdog_sync.desc: After DOGE’s billion-to-million correction, this group insists on counting the zeroes itself. Inspectors general huddle to compare sealed reports.

fundraiser_detour.desc: The LFPA25 cancellation is today’s topic; neighbors are supplying what the talking points cannot. You are asked to crash a friendly fundraiser.

town_hall_drift.desc: The MAHA report’s citation errors have arrived before its promised confidence. A classic-mode town hall needs calming words.

deep_waystation_boost.desc: The LFPA25 cancellation is today’s topic; neighbors are supplying what the talking points cannot. A local crew waves you onto freshly cleared asphalt.

deep_rustbelt_convoy.desc: Trump’s auto-parts tariffs have turned this roadside conversation into an economics seminar nobody enrolled in. Freight drivers offer to pace you past barricades.

deep_beltway_fastpass.desc: After DOGE’s billion-to-million correction, this group insists on counting the zeroes itself. Policy aides flash badges to keep traffic enforcement off you.

clinic_triage.desc: The MAHA report’s citation errors have arrived before its promised confidence. A volunteer medic wagon offers hydration and quick checks.

overnight_briefing.desc: The administration’s five-accomplishment emails have arrived here in spirit, if not in competence. Allies urge you to pause, sleep, and align strategy before dawn.

sat_straw_reserve.name: Emergency Straw Reserve
sat_straw_reserve.desc: A roadside depot celebrates Trump’s straw order with a mountain of plastic straws. The water shipment is still pending approval.
sat_straw_reserve.choice_0: Buy water from the uncelebrated cooler
sat_straw_reserve.log_0: Water reaches your crew without a signing ceremony.
sat_straw_reserve.choice_1: Inventory the strategic straws for pay
sat_straw_reserve.log_1: You earn ten dollars and lose the ability to hear the word strategic calmly.
sat_straw_reserve.log_2: You keep your resources and leave the opportunity behind.

sat_corn_bullets.name: Five Things Corn Did Last Week
sat_corn_bullets.desc: A farm office has adopted the administration’s five-bullet emails. The corn has submitted four. Management suspects loafing.
sat_corn_bullets.log_0: The crop keeps its job. You need a quiet minute.
sat_corn_bullets.choice_1: Help the farmer file for a small fee
sat_corn_bullets.log_1: Your invoice contains five bullet points. All five say paid.
sat_corn_bullets.log_2: You keep your resources and leave the opportunity behind.

sat_grant_groceries.name: Locally Grown Funding Gap
sat_grant_groceries.desc: After the LFPA25 cancellation, this food co-op has vegetables, hungry neighbors and a federal explanation that contains no recipes.
sat_grant_groceries.log_0: Dinner survives its encounter with federal priorities.
sat_grant_groceries.choice_1: Take the co-op’s paid loading shift
sat_grant_groceries.log_1: The co-op pays you. The crates decline to become lighter.
sat_grant_groceries.log_2: You keep your resources and leave the opportunity behind.

sat_cow_citations.name: Peer-Reviewed by the Cow
sat_cow_citations.desc: A MAHA-inspired vendor assures you that every health claim has a citation. The bibliography is mostly the cow’s LinkedIn endorsements.
sat_cow_citations.log_0: Several citations retire to spend more time with their families.
sat_cow_citations.log_1: Your lunch has an ingredients list and no honorary doctorate.
sat_cow_citations.log_2: You keep your resources and leave the opportunity behind.

sat_forecast_corrected.name: The Forecast Has Been Corrected
sat_forecast_corrected.desc: Inspired by Sharpiegate, the local spin desk has drawn sunshine over the rain radar. The windshield refuses to cooperate.
sat_forecast_corrected.choice_0: Use the forecaster’s actual shelter advice
sat_forecast_corrected.log_0: You stay dry. The marker remains scientifically unnecessary.
sat_forecast_corrected.log_1: The briefing is cheerful. Your socks are a rebuttal.
sat_forecast_corrected.log_2: You keep your resources and leave the opportunity behind.

sat_parking_gulf.name: Gulf of Parking Lot
sat_parking_gulf.desc: Following Trump’s renaming spree, a rest stop declares its puddle the Gulf of Premium Parking. The fee applies at low tide too.
sat_parking_gulf.choice_0: Paint the new sign for seven dollars
sat_parking_gulf.log_0: A puddle gains prestige. You gain gas money.
sat_parking_gulf.choice_1: Mark the actual exit on the map
sat_parking_gulf.log_1: The crew escapes without recognizing the puddle’s sovereignty.
sat_parking_gulf.log_2: You keep your resources and leave the opportunity behind.

sat_library_minimum.name: The Minimum Viable Library
sat_library_minimum.desc: After Trump’s IMLS reduction order, a librarian prepares an emergency plan: one book, chained to a printer that only prints funding applications.
sat_library_minimum.log_0: The children get stories with endings.
sat_library_minimum.choice_1: Digitize the backup catalog for pay
sat_library_minimum.log_1: You preserve the books. The application still wants a fax.
sat_library_minimum.log_2: You keep your resources and leave the opportunity behind.

sat_tariff_forklift.name: The Tariff Relabeling Shift
sat_tariff_forklift.desc: A freight yard responding to Trump’s tariffs needs help moving boxes between CURRENT RATE and PLEASE CHECK AGAIN. The labels are wearing out first.
sat_tariff_forklift.log_0: You earn actual dollars moving hypothetical certainty.
sat_tariff_forklift.log_1: The dispatcher pays in snacks with a stable exchange rate.
sat_tariff_forklift.log_2: You keep your resources and leave the opportunity behind.

sat_alternator_tariff.name: The Patriotic Parts Counter
sat_alternator_tariff.desc: At a shop responding to Trump’s auto-parts tariffs, imported emergency supplies cost more. A red-white-and-blue sticker is available for an additional emergency.
sat_alternator_tariff.choice_0: Buy the clearly priced roadside kit
sat_alternator_tariff.log_0: Three bundles enter the van. The sticker stays behind.
sat_alternator_tariff.choice_1: Audit the invoice with the mechanic
sat_alternator_tariff.log_1: You locate the tariff, the markup and the freedom handling fee.
sat_alternator_tariff.log_2: You keep your resources and leave the opportunity behind.

sat_billion_pothole.name: The Eight-Billion-Dollar Pothole
sat_billion_pothole.desc: A DOGE-style savings board has valued this pothole in billions. The crew suspects three extra zeroes. The pothole remains unimpressed by its valuation.
sat_billion_pothole.log_0: The savings lose weight. Your evidence gains it.
sat_billion_pothole.log_1: You repair a real hole for a real ten dollars.
sat_billion_pothole.log_2: You keep your resources and leave the opportunity behind.

sat_bridge_bullets.name: Please Account for the Bridge
sat_bridge_bullets.desc: A bridge crew must list five accomplishments in the style of the administration’s emails. Preventing collapse apparently counts as only one.
sat_bridge_bullets.choice_0: Translate structural engineering into five bullets
sat_bridge_bullets.log_0: The bridge is still standing. The email is finally long enough.
sat_bridge_bullets.choice_1: Bring lunch while they finish the report
sat_bridge_bullets.log_1: The crew can eat without documenting each bite.
sat_bridge_bullets.log_2: You keep your resources and leave the opportunity behind.

sat_press_pool_radio.name: Unscheduled Press Pool
sat_press_pool_radio.desc: After the administration’s Signal fiasco, a convoy dispatcher discovers the lunch-order chat also contains tomorrow’s security briefing. And a restaurant critic.
sat_press_pool_radio.choice_0: Separate lunch from the sensitive channel
sat_press_pool_radio.log_0: The critic is removed. The sandwiches remain under review.
sat_press_pool_radio.choice_1: Rebuild the contact list for a fee
sat_press_pool_radio.log_1: Eight dollars buys more contact hygiene than the old system had.
sat_press_pool_radio.log_2: You keep your resources and leave the opportunity behind.

sat_hydration_pressure.name: Hydration Sovereignty
sat_hydration_pressure.desc: A truck stop inspired by Trump’s showerhead order advertises executive water pressure. The demonstration has washed the suggestion box into the road.
sat_hydration_pressure.log_0: You get clean without declaring a constitutional victory.
sat_hydration_pressure.choice_1: Help repair the demonstration stand for pay
sat_hydration_pressure.log_1: The plumbing accepts your wrench more readily than a proclamation.
sat_hydration_pressure.log_2: You keep your resources and leave the opportunity behind.

sat_museum_grant.name: The Exhibit of Pending Funds
sat_museum_grant.desc: Following the IMLS reduction order, this museum opens a new exhibit: a velvet rope around the grant application. Nobody may touch its outcome.
sat_museum_grant.choice_0: Digitize exhibits for the museum’s day rate
sat_museum_grant.log_0: You preserve history before the application becomes an artifact.
sat_museum_grant.log_1: The tour has facts, unlike the funding timetable.
sat_museum_grant.log_2: You keep your resources and leave the opportunity behind.

sat_factcheck_shift.name: Citation Repair Is Hiring
sat_factcheck_shift.desc: A local paper needs a freelancer after the MAHA report’s citation errors. The editor promises more real dollars than some references had real authors.
sat_factcheck_shift.log_0: Fifteen dollars. Several broken citations. One intact standard of evidence.
sat_factcheck_shift.log_1: The editor declines your services. Confidence briefly replaces verification.
sat_factcheck_shift.log_2: You keep your resources and leave the opportunity behind.

sat_food_shelf.name: The Shelf Is Still Hungry
sat_food_shelf.desc: The LFPA25 cancellation has inspired a agency sign: FOOD ACCESS STREAMLINED. Volunteers are streamlining potatoes into actual bags.
sat_food_shelf.choice_0: Help pack food in exchange for three bundles
sat_food_shelf.log_0: Your crew gets supplies. Your arms get a government-sized workload.
sat_food_shelf.choice_1: Handle the co-op’s paid delivery paperwork
sat_food_shelf.log_1: The co-op pays ten dollars for forms that finally correspond to food.
sat_food_shelf.log_2: You keep your resources and leave the opportunity behind.

sat_cabinet_guest.name: Cabinet Chat: Guest Access
sat_cabinet_guest.desc: Your checkpoint invitation follows the Signal scandal’s approach to access control: a lock icon, total confidence, and a man asking whether this is his dentist.
sat_cabinet_guest.log_0: You remove the dentist’s patient before sharing the route.
sat_cabinet_guest.choice_1: Post the itinerary and a thumbs-up
sat_cabinet_guest.log_1: The group appreciates your openness. So does somebody called External Guest 4.
sat_cabinet_guest.log_2: You keep your resources and leave the opportunity behind.

sat_name_infrastructure.name: The Name Is the Infrastructure
sat_name_infrastructure.desc: The renaming office has learned from Trump’s geographic order. Your missing bridge is now called The Tremendous Connection. The river has not signed off.
sat_name_infrastructure.choice_0: Pay for the newly named detour permit
sat_name_infrastructure.log_0: The permit is excellent. You still take the detour.
sat_name_infrastructure.choice_1: Demand a route with physical pavement
sat_name_infrastructure.log_1: The clerk locates a road that exists outside the press release.
sat_name_infrastructure.log_2: You keep your resources and leave the opportunity behind.

sat_straw_inspection.name: Strategic Straw Inspection
sat_straw_inspection.desc: A checkpoint has interpreted Trump’s paper-straw order as a border doctrine. Your reusable cup is being questioned about its affiliations.
sat_straw_inspection.choice_0: Offer a sealed drink to end the inspection
sat_straw_inspection.log_0: The inspector finds the beverage ideologically sufficient.
sat_straw_inspection.choice_1: Read the actual procurement order aloud
sat_straw_inspection.log_1: The cup is released without charges.
sat_straw_inspection.log_2: You keep your resources and leave the opportunity behind.

sat_shower_force.name: The National Shower Demonstration
sat_shower_force.desc: A promotional booth for Trump’s showerhead order needs a volunteer to hold the hose. Its pressure is presidential; its fasteners are municipal.
sat_shower_force.log_0: You earn twelve dollars restraining executive water pressure.
sat_shower_force.log_1: You wash off the road without becoming part of the demonstration.
sat_shower_force.log_2: You keep your resources and leave the opportunity behind.

sat_receipt_museum.name: The Museum of Very Large Savings
sat_receipt_museum.desc: The exhibit commemorating DOGE’s billion-to-million correction has a donation box labeled TRILLIONS. The curator needs someone who understands decimal places.
sat_receipt_museum.choice_0: Audit the exhibit for an honorarium
sat_receipt_museum.log_0: The museum pays thirteen dollars. You verify all thirteen.
sat_receipt_museum.log_1: The applause is tremendous. The accounting is performance art.
sat_receipt_museum.log_2: You keep your resources and leave the opportunity behind.

sat_transit_ribbon.name: The Ribbon-Cutting Holding Pattern
sat_transit_ribbon.desc: A transit advocacy booth displays Chicago’s funding-pause news. The ribbon is ready, the scissors are ready, and neither is accepted as public transportation.
sat_transit_ribbon.log_0: The campaign gets lunch. Commuters still need actual transit.
sat_transit_ribbon.log_1: You collect nine dollars and several unusually specific sighs.
sat_transit_ribbon.log_2: You keep your resources and leave the opportunity behind.

sat_weather_desk.name: Alternative Weather Desk
sat_weather_desk.desc: A briefing contractor has learned the wrong lesson from Sharpiegate: every unfavorable forecast needs a thicker pen. You are offered the corrections desk.
sat_weather_desk.log_0: The weather is unchanged. The record is finally accurate.
sat_weather_desk.choice_1: Accept six dollars to redraw the sunshine
sat_weather_desk.log_1: The chart improves politically. The clouds remain insubordinate.
sat_weather_desk.log_2: You keep your resources and leave the opportunity behind.

sat_bibliography_emergency.name: Bibliography Emergency Room
sat_bibliography_emergency.desc: After the MAHA report’s errors, a clinic has opened a citation triage desk. The references have impressive titles but no detectable authors.
sat_bibliography_emergency.log_0: Twelve dollars earned. The bibliography regains a pulse.
sat_bibliography_emergency.choice_1: Use the clinic’s ordinary care supplies
sat_bibliography_emergency.log_1: Your crew improves under a treatment that exists.
sat_bibliography_emergency.log_2: You keep your resources and leave the opportunity behind.

play.travel_help: Set your pace and information diet, then travel. The road runs briefly before stopping at your next decision. Watch the gauges; choices and repairs report their actual costs.
play.outfit_help: Your starting funds pay for the selected cart. There are no free supplies underneath it. Add or remove food, water, parts and protection; you may leave empty. Purchases are charged when you depart. A spare is consumed only when fitted.
play.review_help: Check what you are carrying and what you will have left. These purchases happen when you start the journey.
play.capacity: Supplies are capped at 20. Extra provisions above that limit do not carry over.
play.pack_empty: A starter load is selected. Every item comes out of your funds—change or remove anything.
play.fuel_food_help: Food and water add supplies. Water also gives you a water-jug equipment tag.
play.vehicle_help: One matching spare is consumed when fitted. Without one, repairs may cost cash, time, or vehicle condition.
play.ppe_help: Protective gear softens specific weather penalties. Select an item to see what it protects against.
play.docs_help: A press pass can help at permit checks. A legal fund adds credibility.
play.pace_help: Faster travel brings more stress and encounter risk. These are configured daily modifiers, not a guarantee of distance.
play.diet_help: This is your news intake, not your food ration. Quieter coverage supports sanity; doomscrolling raises receipt-finding chances and pants danger.
play.locked: Today’s settings are locked until the next day.
play.weather_help: These modifiers describe the current weather. Conditions can change as the next day begins. Protective gear can replace some penalties.
play.cred_help: Credibility rises by listening to locals, documenting events and useful encounter choices. Misleading claims and some shortcuts reduce it. It affects the final hearing.
play.morale_help: Morale is the crew’s shared spirit. Care, rest, cooperation and successful encounters raise it. Losses, departures, hunger and difficult choices lower it.
play.sanity_help: News intake, rushed travel, illness and stressful choices can lower sanity. Quiet news, camp recovery and helpful encounters restore it. A warning appears at 2 or less.
play.health_help: Health falls through injury, hunger and hard physical work. Care, recovery days and some encounters restore it. At zero the journey ends.
play.supplies_help: Food and water share a 20-unit capacity. Travel, weather, care and barter use supplies. Buy provisions, gather outside town, trade or work for food to replenish them.
play.allies_help: Allies are outside supporters, separate from the people in your van. Helpful encounter choices build support; choices that spend or alienate support reduce it. Allies contribute to the final hearing.
play.travel_wait: Watch the road. Your next decision is approaching.
play.travel_done: You made it through this stretch.
play.journal_empty: The journal fills as your journey unfolds.
play.repair_help: Choose a repair and review its cost before fitting a part or calling for help.
play.danger: Sanity is in the danger zone
play.danger_help: Your sanity is 2 or lower. Consider rest or a quieter information diet before pushing on.
play.unknown_log: Trail conditions changed. Check the latest resource receipt.
play.seed_hint: Use a run code to replay a journey. Leave the generated code as-is for this trip.

play_log.jury: An improvised repair got you moving at a cost to vehicle condition.
play_log.blocked: Travel is blocked by a breakdown.
play_log.service: Roadside service was arranged. See the cash and condition changes.
play_log.field: A field repair kept the vehicle moving.
play_log.partial: You made progress along the route.
play_log.detour: You took a detour around the crossing.
play_log.bribe: A bribe was attempted at the crossing.
play_log.permit: Your permit was presented at the crossing.
play_log.capitol: You are approaching the final checkpoint.
play_log.defeat: The final vote did not pass.

play2.autosave_failed: Automatic recovery could not be saved. Use Save or export your game before leaving.
play2.trade_done: Traded 3 supplies for 1 spare tire. The community thanks you for keeping barter out of the subscription economy.
play2.stop_help: Stock up before departure. One community exchange per stop; leaving takes you back onto the trail.
play2.purchase_done: Your purchases are packed. Check the receipt before getting back on the road.
play2.weather_changed: Conditions changed. Weather affects distance, exposure and daily resources; your gear may reduce the impact. The turn receipt shows the combined result.

crew.title: 为队伍起名
crew.name: 队伍名称
crew.hint: 我们为队员随机选择了中性名字。你可以保留，也可以输入喜欢的名字。

route.title: 通往D.C.之路
route.services: 补给商店 · 社区交易
route.help: Supply shops and community trades open when you reach a town. Your map returns at new towns, regional borders, and every five days.

origin_satire.journalist: Minneapolis to D.C. — Midwest nice. Federal fine print.
origin_satire.organizer: Kansas City to D.C. — The barbecue committee has reached no consensus.
origin_satire.whistleblower: Denver to D.C. — Even the thin air comes with a premium tier.
origin_satire.lobbyist: St. Louis to D.C. — The arch is free to admire. Access costs extra.
origin_satire.staffer: Omaha to D.C. — Every cornfield has a field office.
origin_satire.satirist: Austin to D.C. — Everything is bigger, especially the invoices.

journey.camp_forecast: These are the recovery effects at your current levels. One stationary day passes; weather and hunger can also affect the crew. Rest helps every present crew member.
journey.capacity: The van holds 20 supply units. Remove surplus packs before checkout; you will not be charged for goods you cannot carry.
journey.shop_help: Restock for the next leg. Your current supplies and spares are already in the van.
journey.rolling: On the road. Travel continues until a decision, arrival or danger needs you.
journey.arrival_help: The road can wait. Restock, exchange goods or hear what the locals know before departing.
journey.town_heartland: The grain elevator has been renamed the Center for Agricultural Innovation. It still buys grain. Neighbors recommend a spare tire for the rural stretch ahead; volunteers run the aid table. Your notes add credibility.
journey.town_rustbelt: The old mill is an Innovation District now. The library still has working outlets. Locals recommend a spare battery; the exchange board lists today’s offer. You record their account.
journey.town_beltway: The community center is accepting feedback about the feedback process. Neighbors point out the actual aid desk around the back. Gather your evidence and rest before the D.C. hearing.
journey.care_body: {name} is worn down after days on the road. A volunteer aid team stops alongside you. Help now, arrange a safe departure, or keep going with a risk of worsening illness.
journey.care_critical: {name} is critically ill after care was deferred. Continuing without treatment will be fatal. The aid team can help, and a recovery day can also clear this condition.
journey.shelter_action: Arrange a safe departure · Crew member leaves · Morale −{morale}
journey.defer_action: Keep going · Sanity −{sanity} · Illness may worsen
journey.fatal_action: Continue without care · This crew member will die · Sanity −{sanity} · Morale −{morale}
journey.care_hint: These choices take one hour. A full rest day clears crew illness; returning to a menu does not.
journey.care_helped: {name} receives care and can help the crew again.
journey.care_sheltered: {name} stays with the volunteer aid team and leaves the expedition safely. Their seat is now empty.
journey.care_deferred: {name} stays with the crew, still unwell. Give care or take a recovery day before the condition worsens.
journey.care_lost: {name} died after critical illness went untreated. The crew continues without them.
journey.mission: Bring the crew and evidence of institutional nonsense to a public hearing in D.C. Gather receipts, build credibility and find allies along the way. Arriving is only part of it: the crew needs enough sanity to be heard.
journey.multiplier: Affects final scoring, not your travel speed or starting cash.
journey.vote_exhausted: The crew cannot withstand the full hearing at these levels. Recover before proceeding.
journey.vote_chance: Estimated chance of passing the final vote: {chance}%.
journey.vote_basis: Evidence, credibility, allies, health, morale and supplies contribute to the journey score. Days and resolved encounters add experience; breakdowns subtract from it. Sanity and pants danger must survive the hearing’s round costs. The final vote is uncertain.
journey.vote_won: The hearing passed. Your crew’s account is on the record in D.C.
journey.vote_lost: The hearing ended without a win. The journey and the people who helped still count.
journey.forecast: Recent supply use: about {days} days of stock. Conditions and choices can change this.
journey.forecast_wait: Supply outlook appears after the first travel day. Carry a reserve for weather, care and delays.
journey.abandon_explanation: This ends the current journey and saves its story. You can start a new trip or load a separate manual save.
journey.abandoned_story: {name} chose to end the trail here with {crew}. Your journey and everyone who traveled with you remain in the journal.

trail.shop_help: Supply shop. Buy food, water, spare parts and protective gear with cash at this stop.
trail.trade_help: Community trading. Exchange goods or work for supplies; local offers are available once per stop.
trail.repair_context: The van cannot continue. Parts and local contacts near {town} offer these routes back onto the road.
trail.repair_radio: Call local radio; work in exchange for repairs
trail.repair_help: A fitted spare is consumed. Buying outside town includes $10 delivery. Barter consumes four supplies. Radio contacts arrange a used part in exchange for four hours of work, costing sanity and morale. The radio option remains available without cash or spares.
trail.repaired: The {part} is fitted. The crew checks the van before continuing.
trail.gather_help: Outside town, gather once every three travel days. Choose a short forage or harder work with more food. In towns, choose one paid or food-for-work offer per stop. Supplies cannot exceed 20; unavailable choices show their costs before you commit.
trail.work_supplies: Sort donations for a food parcel
trail.forage_done: Your guide identifies what can be gathered safely. The crew returns with food and a clearer head.
trail.glean_done: The farmer shares the harvest. Lifting and carrying have taken a physical toll.
trail.work_supplies_done: The donation shelves are stocked and the crew receives an agreed food parcel.
trail.work_cash_done: The unloading shift is complete. Payment goes directly into the crew’s cash reserve.
trail.gather_wait: Gathering available again in {days} travel days.
trail.work_done: You have completed this stop’s work offer. More offers await in the next town.
trail.fact_note: Local facts are sourced. The resident and their commentary are fictional.
trail.care_reason_0: {name} tried raw milk from a MAHA-themed stall. The promised health revolution has become a stomach emergency.
trail.care_reason_1: {name} trusted a sunshine forecast corrected with a marker. The resulting dehydration has no comment for the press.
trail.care_reason_2: {name} spent the night reconstructing five accomplishments for a DOGE-inspired camp supervisor. Sleep did not make the list.
trail.care_reason_3: {name} sampled a wellness cure whose bibliography was inspired by the MAHA report. The nausea has better documentation.
trail.care_reason_4: {name} followed three freshly renamed detours. The road gained prestige; {name} lost sleep.
trail.care_reason_5: {name} spent hours verifying a parts invoice after the latest tariff explanation. They are exhausted and still on hold.
trail.care_reason_6: {name} was accidentally added to a Signal-inspired overnight briefing chat. The notifications have outlasted their sanity.
trail.care_reason_7: {name} strained their back loading food parcels after a co-op meeting about the LFPA25 cancellation. The press release weighed less.
trail.satire_note: The roadside scene, dialogue and resource prices are fictional satire inspired by this documented episode.

offline.title: Offline play
offline.error: Download interrupted. Your saved run is safe.
offline.unavailable: Offline storage is unavailable in this browser.
offline.install_help: On iPhone or iPad, use Share → Add to Home Screen. On a supported desktop browser, use its Install app or Add to Dock command. Installation options depend on your browser.
offline.help: All game scenes, maps and rules download automatically. Wait for Ready for offline play before disconnecting. The game checks for a complete update before starting online. Your browser stores the game and saves locally; clearing site data removes them.
